relevance_note: Single case report of a NOD2 carrier with Blau syndrome: 'a novel heterozygote mutation P507S (c.1519C>T) in the fourth exon of the NOD2 gene was revealed'.
method_note: Read by hand; JSON assembled with a small Python script from hand-chosen values and spans. One in-scope person (single unnamed case-report patient, label 'patient'). The parents are mentioned only as 'healthy' and were not stated to be tested, so they get no rows; inheritance is 'not reported' because the authors only 'believe' the variant is de novo without stating parental testing ('we believe ade novo mutation caused the Blau syndrome'). Age at Blau diagnosis is not stated explicitly (diagnosis followed the uveitis found at 5 years) and is left not reported. ESR 15 mm/h, WBC 12600 and platelets 446000 were given without interpretation and are not recorded as features. 'No rash' refers to the examination at 3 years after the infant rash had resolved; it is recorded as an excluded row with that context, while the checklist item is observed because of the earlier rash (not a contradiction, different time points). Fever was drug-induced (etanercept); checklist fever marked observed on that basis. Tenosynovitis checklist marked observed from the authors' statement that granulomatous inflammation causing tenosynovial cysts was observed. Variant type not stated by the authors, so 'not reported'. 'Antinuclear antibody negative' recorded as excluded 'positive antinuclear antibody' per D-27. No contradictions found.
